notes.subject: וַתִּטְפֹּל
notes.rationale: S talɣa tamirkanit: 'ad yessbelḍ am usgel ɣef' (KJV 'sewest up'), 'ad yessifu' (Wycliffe 'curid'), neɣ 'ad yernu' (Geneva/JPS 'addest/heapest') — iṭṭafar-d kan iman-is deg umaḍal amsuqel.

notes.subject: tessexleḍ ula d
notes.rationale: ותטפל qbel-nni d 'ad yeslug ɣef wayeḍ'; qqimeɣ ɣer unamek n Genesis-1599 'ad yezid' axaṭer d win yugaren tagi deg tseddart.

notes.subject: עַל
notes.rationale: Taɛrabt tamezwarut n wawal-agi ur tessaweḍ ara deg taqbaylit deg wawal-nni n tsuqilt tamezwarut, tessawel-d kan i wawal i d-iteddun.

translation: Aɣelluy-iw yettwamdel deg ukar, tessexleḍ ula d tuccḍa-iw.
